facts.fact: Decree 11/2025 of 16 May 2025 (Council of Ministers, approved 22 April 2025) approves a new regulation of the Universal Access Service Fund (FSAU), repealing Decree 62/2017, and fixes the levy at 1% of each licensed telecom operator's prior-year gross revenue, with the money applied to rural infrastructure (up to 55%), digital inclusion, broadcasting, running costs and innovation; it also assigns 60% of fines under the regulation to the fund and names state budget allocations as a revenue source, but states no amount collected or paid out.
